question: Should the Control UI tool-result image entry stay in this changelog PR by first landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100295, or should it be removed until that fix is on main?
rationale: The changelog is release-owned and this PR is maintainer-labeled, so the remaining blocker is release sequencing rather than an ordinary contributor repair.

options.title: Defer the Control UI entry
options.body: Remove the Control UI line from this PR and add it back after the linked fix is merged.

options.title: Land the dependency first
options.body: Merge the Control UI fix first, then rebase this PR so the entry describes behavior already present on main.

options.title: Stage as a batch entry
options.body: Keep the line only if maintainers explicitly own the sequencing risk and ensure both PRs ship together.

recommendation.title: Defer the Control UI entry
recommendation.body: Remove the Control UI line from this PR and add it back after the linked fix is merged.
